While I look that up — I can already tell you the key numbers regardless of where you are in your cycle. Switching to annual billing will never cost you more than staying monthly. Here is what you need to know:
Your new annual charge will be $15 × 32 × 12 = $5,760 billed once per year, compared to $576 × 12 = $6,912 if you stayed monthly. That is a saving of $1,152 per year.
When you switch, Lumo will show you the exact proration amount on the confirmation screen before you commit — so you will see the precise number before anything is charged. It will be a small credit or a small charge depending on where you are in your cycle, but in either case it will be under $96 since that is the maximum monthly difference between the two rates for your seat count
